title: Minimal Agent Workbench
motto: The smallest useful workbench is three files: a root instructions router, a state file, and a task board. Everything else is layered on top. If a repo cannot carry these three, no model will save it.

steps.title: Core idea
steps.body: The smallest useful workbench is three files: a root instructions router, a state file, and a task board. Everything else is layered on top. If a repo cannot carry these three, no model will save it.

steps.title: The problem
cards: Most teams reach for a workbench by writing a 3000-line `AGENTS.md` and calling it done. The model loads it, ignores the parts it cannot summarize, and still fails on the same surfaces it always failed on.

You need the opposite. A tiny root file that routes the agent into deeper files only when relevant. Durable state the agent reads before acting and writes after. A task board that says what is in flight, what is blocked, and what is up next.
Three files. Each one with a job. Each one machine-readable enough to evolve into a real system later.
